title: Score follow
description: A fine red playhead follows an original four-bar melody across a sharply engraved white score.
useCase: Music practice, score previews, and notation synchronized with a controllable beat timeline.
interaction: Play, change the tempo, or drag the score to seek
reducedMotion: The playhead advances between note positions instead of moving continuously. Playback starts only on request.
limitations: Silent visual notation with an original fixed melody; not a MusicXML parser, audio scheduler, or notation engraving engine.
look: Light grey page with a white sheet of crisp black engraved notation on a five-line staff, red playhead accents and a round red play button.
motion: Pressing play sweeps a thin red playhead linearly across four bars at the set tempo (88 BPM default), turning the current note red; dragging the score scrubs.
adapt: Playback is the `requestAnimationFrame` `tick` advancing `cursor` by `tempo` beats per minute, mapped to x by `noteX`; the current note comes from `PHRASE` timing. Replace `PHRASE` (start beat, staff step, duration) and the 16-beat length with your own score.
